instruction: Show current capabilities for a user process

output: for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do echo -n "PID $pid: "; getpcaps $pid 2>/dev/null; done

for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do cap=$(grep CapEff /proc/$pid/status 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); if [ "$cap" ] && capsh --decode=$cap 2>/dev/null | grep -q cap_net_admin; then echo "PID $pid: $(cat /proc/$pid/comm 2>/dev/null)"; fi; done

for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do cap=$(grep CapEff /proc/$pid/status 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); [ "$cap" ] && capsh --decode=$cap 2>/dev/null | grep -q cap_sys_admin && echo "PID $pid: $(cat /proc/$pid/comm 2>/dev/null)"; done

instruction: Check capabilities for current shell process
Show capability evolution in process tree
output: for pid in $(pstree -p $$ | grep -oP '\d+'); do echo "PID $pid: $(grep CapEff /proc/$pid/status 2>/dev/null)"; done

instruction: Show all thread capabilities in process
output: for tid in /proc/1234/task/*; do echo "TID $(basename $tid): $(grep CapEff $tid/status 2>/dev/null)"; done

instruction: Change capabilities of a running process

output: busctl introspect org.freedesktop.DBus /org/freedesktop/DBus 2>/dev/null | grep -i cap || echo 'No D-Bus capability info'
